phase_commands.command: /ideate Build the local reference service described in seed.md. Work autonomously, retain every seed constraint, and stop before remote mutation.
/brainstorm Turn the selected reference-service idea into complete requirements. Work autonomously and use the existing ideation artifact.
/plan Build a decision-complete plan from the promoted reference-service specification.
/doc-review Review and safely fix the current reference-service plan until no actionable P0 through P3 finding remains.
/resume Reconstruct this reference lifecycle from repository evidence and route to the earliest unsettled obligation.
/work Implement the reviewed reference-service plan locally. Do not push, open a pull request, create an issue, change a board, merge, or deploy.
/code-review Review the complete local reference-service branch and write the durable review artifact.
/qa Validate the implemented reference service against its requirements and write the durable quality-assurance artifact.
/retro Review this reference lifecycle and write the durable retrospective without changing global or remote state.
/handoff Prepare and promote a local handoff envelope for the completed reference service. Target team Operations and target repository infiquetra-antigravity-plugins. Do not create the issue.
